mapper.insert: INSERT INTO session_attendance ( session_id, student_id, student_no, student_name, class_code, status, remark, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{studentId}, #{studentNo}, #{studentName}, #{classCode}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} ) ON CONFLICT (session_id, student_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id AS sessionId, student_id AS studentId, student_no AS studentNo, student_name AS studentName, class_code AS classCode, status, remark, recorded_by AS recordedBy, recorded_at AS recordedAt, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM session_attendance WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY student_no ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE session_attendance SET status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, recorded_by = #{recordedBy}, recorded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
